'''Bojam Rees''' was a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who had a shop on [[Starstation 12]].

When [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Abal Karda]], an enemy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] on the run for the murder of [[Nim|his commanding offcer]] arrived on the station aboard the freighter ''[[Port-Esta Queen]]'', he visited Rees's shop to acquire a disguise. The tattooist marked Karda's face with the tribal patterns of the [[Duhma]], and the fugitive [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] paid for his service with [[Icarii]] jewels. Rees subsequently changed them into cash, which the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used as a clue in his pursuit of Karda.
